name: openvideo
title_zh: 本地剪片先分析后动刀，静音自动清、多机位自动拼
tagline_zh: 素材堆成山？它先本地跑完场景分析，再按叙事下刀。静音段自动剔除，多机位自动对齐，Remotion 生成片头片尾。
tagline_en: Overwhelmed by footage? It analyzes locally first, then cuts by narrative. Auto-removes silences, syncs.
desc_en: Orchestrate AI video editing across local media analysis, narrative cuts, silence removal, multivideo, authored Remotion visuals, preview, and rendering.
why_zh: 不是套模板的傻瓜剪辑，而是先理解内容再决定怎么剪。分析在本地完成，不上传素材，叙事结构由你定义。
why_en: Not template-based trimming—it understands content before cutting. Analysis stays local, you define the narrative arc, it does.
limit_zh: 需要 Node.js 环境和 ffmpeg；只处理本地文件，不接云存储。分析基于镜头和音频。
limit_en: Requires Node.js & ffmpeg; local files only, no cloud. Detects cuts & audio, not objects/faces. Output is a Remotion project, not an MP4.
title_en: Local AI video editor: analyze, cut silences, splice.
